mapper.select: SELECT s.*, u.name as student_name, c.course_name, cl.class_name FROM score s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.student_id = u.id LEFT JOIN course c ON s.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN class cl ON u.class_id = cl.id ORDER BY s.id DESC
